Method of Attack: Denial of service, escalation of privileges, or information disclosure via kernel mode layer handler for DxgkDdiEscape (CVE-2019-5675); Denial of service via buffer over-read in kernel mode layer handler for DeviceIoControl (CVE-2019-5677)
Impacted Systems: NVIDIA GPU Display Driver on Windows machines
Attack Vector: Local user access required but can be exploited remotely by dropping malicious tools on computers running unpatched NVIDIA GPU Display Driver
